systems.system: National Identification System / Burkinabe National Identity Card (CNIB)
systems.tiers: listed as the foundational ID with no digital ID; adult coverage of 90 per cent or above on the 2024 Findex survey (fieldwork 20 July to 17 August 2024)

note: A global identity-coverage dataset; for Burkina Faso it gives adult identity-card ownership only, and nothing on civil registration offices or how births and deaths are recorded.
